mapper.select: SELECT id, item_id AS itemId, lot_number AS lotNumber, quantity, scheduled_date AS scheduledDate, production_date AS productionDate, status, trigger_source AS triggerSource FROM production_orders WHERE id = #{id}
SELECT id, item_id AS itemId, lot_number AS lotNumber, quantity, production_date AS productionDate, status FROM production_orders WHERE lot_number = #{lotNumber}
